Une carte cadeau ou un forfait vendu n’e: A gift card or package sold is not revenue: it earns nothing until it is used. A service paid with a gift card counts once, as the service. A package session is credited to the barber who did it, at the value of one session (price paid for the package ÷ number of sessions).
Cette personne ne fait pas partie de l’é: This person is not on the team.
Des rendez-vous sans barbier occupent dé: Bookings with no barber already fill this slot: assign them to someone or pick another time.
Deux plages par jour pour une pause déje: Two ranges a day for a lunch break (e.g. 09:00–13:00 then 14:00–19:00).
Jours fériés, vacances : personne n’est: Holidays, vacations: nobody can be booked on those days.
Les jours et heures de travail de chaque: Each person's working days and hours. Without their own hours, a person follows the shop's (set in “Online booking”). Customers can never book outside them.
Un jour précis pour une personne : absen: One specific day for one person: away, or with other hours.
Un rendez-vous existe déjà sur ce crénea: A booking already exists in this slot: move or cancel it first.
Une pause, une absence ou une formation: A break, an absence or a training: the slot is no longer offered to customers or bookable. It is not an appointment.
Aucune case cochée : tout le monde peut: No box ticked: everyone can do it.
Proposé sur la page de réservation publi: Offered on the public booking page.
Ajouter, appeler, installer et retirer u: Add, call, seat and remove a customer from the queue
Ce client est déjà installé : terminez s: This customer is already seated: finish their appointment.
Clients sans rendez-vous : file ordonnée: Walk-in customers: ordered queue, estimated wait, “call the next” and a public screen.
Les clients sans rendez-vous, dans l’ord: Walk-in customers in order of arrival. A called customer holds the barber's time: nobody can book over them.
New address for the public screen.
À afficher en salle d’attente : numéro,: To display in the waiting room: number, first name and estimated wait only. Updates by itself.
